description: Use this when you will make many calls or run feeds and want to pay once instead of per call. Omit credit_token to open a new account: the result includes a btf_ token shown ONCE, store it. Lightning: pass bundle or amount_sats (100 to 1,000,000) to get an invoice, pay it, then call again with payment_hash and credit_token to credit it. USDC on Base (x402): pass bundle or amount_usd (0.10 to 50), sign accepts[0], call again with the same amount plus x402_payment; USDC is settled before crediting. Sats pay sats prices, USDC pays USDC list prices; spend with credit_token on any paid tool. Credits are NON-REFUNDABLE; a call that fails is refunded to the balance. Paused feeds resume after credit.

amount_sats.description: Lightning: sats to add (100 to 1,000,000). Alternative to bundle.

amount_usd.description: USDC over x402: dollars to add (0.10 to 50), e.g. "1.00".

bundle.description: A preset amount; see get_pricing for the sats and USD of each.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_...), returned once by buy_credits or create_feed. Send it on every later feed or credit call.

currency.description: With bundle: which currency to pay in.

payment_hash.description: Lightning: check this invoice and credit it if paid, instead of creating a new one.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].

name: buy_credits
title: Buy prepaid credits (Lightning or USDC)
